each snapshot page committed once; at most one re-request per kill

scenarios.description: kill -9 and restart gunicorn at 6 points (after create, mid-snapshot, snapshot end, mid-catch-up, before release, during deltas) while the library changes; the client resumes from its checkpoint and ends with the server's dataset.
scenarios.name: kill_restart

assertions.check: device dataset equals the server's after the republish

scenarios.description: LUM-005-style full republish (every waveform changes, same media) must reach a device at <= 1 KB per track with K6 edge references (P3-2).
scenarios.name: lum005_k6
